_help: Home page shelves and cards. Each card shows only its cover and name. Cover: put a picture in images/covers/ named after the card id with underscores, like crypto_in_5.png; until then a drawn placeholder shows, using color (yellow, blue, coral, mint, violet, orange, pink or teal) and object (cube, key, skull, coins, magnifier, lock, briefcase, badge, trophy, moneybag, pie, moon, button, pizza, rod or rocket). blurb is read out to screen reader users. Toy pages also use topic, font (luckiest, bungee, bangers or chewy) and accent. If you rename a toy, also change its name in its own index.html and in quizzes/index.json. status: live (clickable) or soon (shows a Soon sticker). A card can set its own status to override its shelf. Each live card's id must match its toy file in data/toys/ and its quiz in quizzes/, except cards with kind game, like Spot the Scam, which are stand-alone games without a certificate.
